note: D9: hash-chained tenant partitions of the hybrid ledger (libs/core/governance/ledger.ts TENANT_LEDGER_ROOT): <tier>/<tenant>/ledger.jsonl holds the metadata entries (MISSION_EVENT:*) of tenant missions and the detailed entries of tenant records without a mission ledger; the system ledger active/audit/system-ledger.jsonl keeps untenanted records only. Append-only audit evidence verified by pnpm audit:verify, so no TTL deletion and never rewritten; personal/confidential subtrees are tenant_scope protected prefixes, read and written as the tenant-bound tenant_ledger_store role; tenant offboarding exports and soft-deletes a tenant's partitions. MSN-STORE-BOUNDS-3: each <tier>/<tenant>/ledger.jsonl rotates itself into <tier>/<tenant>/ledger-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss[-n].jsonl under the tenant_ledger_store role (same chain-continuing design as active/audit/system-ledger.jsonl); verify, scoped reads and tenant backup/restore include the segments. The directory stays review_required: segments are tenant audit evidence, moved only by operator decision or the audited offboarding ceremony. Code never archives tenant segments, so a partition missing its oldest segments is always a verification finding (unproven_anchor) and tenant restore refuses it (BACKUP_RESTORE_LEDGER_INCOMPLETE). Mission evidence ledgers (<mission>/evidence/ledger.jsonl) do not rotate.
